title: Tennessee Historical Imagery
description: Tennessee Historical Imagery acquired from 1997-2006. It cover all 95 counties in Tennessee except Knox County. The images are provided in Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF format, which were converted from MrSID format. The original data were downloaded from https://tnmap.maps.arcgis.com/apps/instant/portfolio/index.html?appid=9bd85ab913914bfda59431fee9557f48
